newsitem.title: PERU: Peru 28-day CDs draw 15.45 pct avg rate at sale.
newsitem.headline: Peru 28-day CDs draw 15.45 pct avg rate at sale.

text.p: The Central Reserve Bank of Peru said Wednesday it accepted bids for 56-day Certificates of Deposit (CDs) worth 20 million soles at an effective average annual rate of 15.45 percent during a bank auction BCQZ.
The CDs have a January 16 starting date.
The accepted bids also had a minimum rate of 15.30 percent and a maximum rate of 15.50 percent, the bank said.
At the last CD auction Thursday, 28-day CDs drew an average rate of 14.55 pct.
At Wednesday's auction, the bank said it received bids on the CDs totalling 53.50 million soles.
The bank had offered 20 million soles worth of CDs.
The average effective annual interest rate for the certificates is used as an informal indicator for interest rates in the Peruvian financial system.
